description: Connect to a running Flutter app's Dart VM Service and start collecting runtime data (logs, exceptions, frames, network). Pass the ws:// or http:// URI printed by `flutter run` (line: 'A Dart VM Service ... is available at:'). NOT purely read-only: enables dart:io HTTP timeline logging on the app so network capture works, and adds the GC stream to the VM timeline recorder so garbage-collection pauses can be correlated with jank. Existing recorded streams are preserved, never replaced.

uri.description: VM Service URI, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:52719/abcdef=/ or ws://...

name: connect_vm
title: Connect to Flutter VM Service
